teaser: Vicky Wang stopped reading everything her agents did and started managing them, backed by specialist agents from another team: a model for companies.
core_idea: At Web Summit, Vicky Wang's shift came when she stopped reading everything her agents did and started delegating with instructions, guidance, structure and workflows. She worked at two altitudes, and her agents were backed by specialist agents from another team that unblocked and approved. Companies will want specialist agents (security, legal, data, design, platform) supporting every team, with people giving the guidance only they can.
